papers.title: Certified Static Forecasting
papers.current_ceiling: The exact cost theorem survives, but the explanation vocabulary is incomplete: 64 exact hybrid configurations lie outside the enlarged borrow B'.
post_matrix_updates: Canonical PDF production has improved after #1731; the explanation gap remains scientific.
load_bearing_adverse: QG-7 exhibits 64 exact hybrid configurations not explained by the enlarged vocabulary.
Neither a permanent Psi-vocabulary lower bound nor a mechanism-first new primitive has been established.
A finite vocabulary patched after each counterexample would be post hoc and scientifically weak.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The paper needs either a locality/expressivity lower bound showing that no fixed bounded-arity explanation vocabulary determines exact cost, or one prospectively specified primitive that closes a new family.
papers.decisive_question: For every fixed bounded-arity static explanation vocabulary Psi, do there exist equal-Psi configurations with unequal exact cost, and if so what global primitive is minimally sufficient?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: An impossibility theorem for bounded-local explanations of exact resource cost, paired with a minimal global certificate when one exists.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: Construct an infinite indistinguishable-pair family for any bounded-radius/bounded-arity Psi, or disprove that route by synthesizing a mechanism-defined global invariant and prospectively validating it on unseen configurations.
papers.population_or_universe: All certified configurations generated by the formal system, stratified by size and interaction range; E13 is reserved for later external instantiation.
papers.unit_of_analysis: A pair of configurations with identical Psi signature and their exact certified costs.
historical_only_inputs: The 64 QG-7 hybrids are derivation/counterexample history, not fresh confirmation
design: Define the allowed Psi class parametrically rather than enumerate favourite features.
Seek equal-signature unequal-cost families via locality, covering or communication arguments.
If the lower bound fails, define one new primitive from the causal cost mechanism before generating a fresh challenge.
Only after the theorem is stable, instantiate on Qiskit/tket with native resource estimators.
baselines: All bounded-radius feature counts up to the frozen arity.
Strongest static resource-estimation donor found in E13 literature.
primary_endpoints: Existence and asymptotic size of equal-Psi unequal-cost witness pairs.
Minimum global information needed to restore exactness.
External estimator agreement if E13 is executed.
negative_controls: Pairs differing only in irrelevant local motifs.
Adversarial long-range interaction with identical local neighbourhoods.
analysis_plan: The theoretical endpoint is universal proof or explicit counterexample.
External E13 validation is secondary and must use a new frozen corpus.
Report both explanation failure and exact forecasting success; one does not negate the other.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Prove the unbounded family; finite searches must exhaust every configuration up to the prospectively declared bound.
papers.success_gate: A kernel-checked lower bound plus minimal witnesses across increasing sizes, or a prospectively validated mechanism-first primitive that closes all frozen challenge families.
papers.refutation_gate: One counterexample to the claimed lower bound or failure of the new primitive on the frozen challenge refutes the promoted claim.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if the vocabulary class is not mathematically defined, exact costs cannot be certified or the challenge is generated after primitive tuning.
papers.authority_required: Proof checker and native E13 estimators; an independent systems-theory novelty review is required.

active_lane.collision_rule: No result may overwrite the bounded exact-cost theorem; the explanation failure remains visible.

immediate_safe_actions: Search for a symbolic indistinguishable-pair construction rather than another feature patch.
Refresh Qiskit/tket nearest work before deciding whether external instantiation is material.
forbidden_actions: Do not add primitives after reading fresh labels.
Do not claim explanation completeness from exact forecasting.
Do not hide the 64 hybrid counterexamples.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier theory/systems paper needs a general lower bound or minimal sufficient global invariant, not a sequence of benchmark-specific patches.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns exact cost/explanation vocabulary; online resource allocation belongs to ORION-22.
